title: Accuracy and Order Sensitivity Diverge Under Label-Free Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2608.11947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks are widely used to evaluate large language models, but MCQ scores conflate knowledge with sensitivity to option order, which makes them unreliable measures of model knowledge. In this paper, we test whether preventing a model from seeing option labels while committing to an answer removes positional influence and, in turn, improves performance. We evaluate two different strategies for mitigating bias. The first uses a generation-then-matching approach, and the second scores options in isolation, which is positionally unbiased by construction. Neither reliably improves accuracy. A complete decomposition shows that the bottleneck is withholding options, not the matching step. The only configuration that consistently matches the baseline is the one that shows the model all options paired with an LLM matcher. translated_title: 无标签策略下准确性与顺序敏感性的分歧
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11947v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：多项选择基准测试被广泛用于评估大型语言模型，但多项选择得分将知识与对选项顺序的敏感性混为一谈，这使得它们成为衡量模型知识的不可靠指标。在本文中，我们测试了在模型作答时阻止其看到选项标签是否能消除位置影响，并进而提升性能。我们评估了两种缓解偏差的策略。第一种采用“生成后匹配”的方法，第二种则独立评分选项，该方法在构造上具有位置无偏性。这两种策略均未可靠地提升准确性。完整的分解分析表明，瓶颈在于隐藏选项，而非匹配步骤。唯一能持续匹配基线的配置是向模型展示所有选项并配以LLM匹配器。然而，完全消除位置影响仍不能可靠地带来准确性提升，而循环……
tldr: 本文发现，在无标签策略下，消除选项顺序影响并不能可靠提升大型语言模型的多项选择准确性，且性能瓶颈在于隐藏选项而非匹配过程。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that under label-free strategies, eliminating option-order effects does not reliably improve LLM multiple-choice accuracy, and the bottleneck lies in withholding options rather than the matching step.
